caption: The drawing shows a long dress with a full skirt and long, wide sleeves. The main dress is rendered in full color and features a pattern of alternating vertical stripes. The stripes consist of floral designs with pink roses and green leaves, separated by blue decorative bands set on a cream or off-white background. The dress has a high neckline and fitted bodice that cinches at the waist before extending into the voluminous skirt. Adjacent to the main colored drawing, there is a smaller, uncolored line sketch of the dress, viewed from the back, showing the garment’s general shape and construction without any pattern details. The drawing is set on a plain, light background.
title: Dress
